text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate 13 Nov - HDFC Bank reappointed V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director for one year from November 23, 2026.
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 12 Nov - RBI approved reappointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director for one year from November 23, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 31 Oct - Mr. Sanjay D’Souza superannuated on October 31, 2026, ceasing as Group Head, Business Banking.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate 6 Nov - Shareholders approved Leo Puri as independent director; he becomes chairman from 23 January 2027.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 13 Nov - Avenue Supermarts approved senior management changes effective 16 November 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 13 Nov - Shri Shrirang Anilrao Kothe appointed CEO of Helicopter Complex on 13 November 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate 28 Oct - HAL appointed P B Rangarao as Director (Operations) from 28 Oct 2026; Kota Ravi ceased additional charge.
